bucket_definitions.KEEP-COMMIT: real code, tests, canonical docs, or canonical research artifacts that require isolated review.
bucket_definitions.ARCHIVE: useful receipts, reports, or snapshots that may move only after later G4a approval.
bucket_definitions.DELETE-CANDIDATE: reproducible/generated debris with concrete filename/stat/reference evidence; deletion remains held behind G4b.
bucket_definitions.UNKNOWN: insufficient evidence; defaults to KEEP and requires Hwao/human adjudication.
